name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Exit money, rule dates, maintenance, fees, empty units and enquiries that need someone

sections.title: Needs someone
sections.note: Exit money and rule dates first. Sources for each rule: docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select item,village,record,who,due_date,detail from v_attention order by case when item='EXIT DUE' or item like 'RULE%' then 1 when item='MAINTENANCE OVERDUE' then 2 when item='FEES OVERDUE' then 3 else 4 end,due_date

sections.title: Occupancy
sections.sql: select v.code as village,v.name,count(u.id)::int as units,count(u.id) filter (where exists (select 1 from contracts c where c.unit_id=u.id and c.vacated_on is null))::int as occupied from villages v join units u on u.village_id=v.id group by v.id order by v.code

name: vacancies
title: Empty units
subtitle: Every unit between residents, how long, and what it is costing

sections.title: Between residents
sections.sql: select village,unit,kind,stage,empty_since,days_empty,refurb_started_on,refurb_done_on,first_advertised_on,round(asking_cents/100.0) as asking,round(weekly_fee_cents*days_empty/700.0) as fees_forgone from v_vacancies order by days_empty desc

sections.title: Enquiries in play
sections.sql: select v.code as village,q.name,q.stage,q.wants,q.last_contact_on,q.next_step,q.next_step_on from enquiries q left join villages v on v.id=q.village_id where q.stage not in ('moved in','lost') order by q.next_step_on nulls last

name: money
title: Money owed both ways
subtitle: Exit entitlements the operator owes, and fees residents owe

sections.title: Exit entitlements owed
sections.sql: select village,unit,contract,residents,ended_on,state,round(exit_cents/100.0) as owed,currency,nsw_order_from,pay_by from v_exits where exit_paid_on is null order by coalesce(least(pay_by,nsw_order_from),pay_by,nsw_order_from) nulls last

sections.title: Fees overdue
sections.sql: select village,unit,residents,count(*)::int as charges,round(sum(billed_cents)/100.0,2) as owed,max(days_overdue) as oldest_days from v_arrears group by village,unit,residents order by owed desc

name: compliance
title: Record checks
subtitle: Each finding with the rule it comes from. A record check, not legal advice.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,village,record,residents,finding,due_date,source from v_compliance order by due_date

sections.title: AGM dates
sections.sql: select village,jurisdiction,year_end,agm_by,agm_held_on,last_agm from v_agm order by village
